requirements: 4–5 分钟 Summary AND Response，另加约 1 分钟问答。

sources.locator: ann[0] · Posted on: Wednesday, November 22, 2023 04:05:22 PM CST
sources.quote:
The Individual Presentation will start from 4/5 Dec. For this assessment, please choose one article OR one video as the material. The material should be chosen from the course materials and should not be the same as your practice presentation. The format of the presentation is a Summary AND Response talk (4-5 mins), plus a Q & A session (1 min). Make sure to make the summary brief, preferably to be completed within 2 minutes; the summary only needs to cover the main points of the material chosen. 
Please upload your slides to the Individual Presentation folder, if you choose to use the classroom computer. Otherwise, you need to bring your own device (HDMI connection is required). 
There's no need to dress business formal, but sportswear should be avoided. Only students scheduled to present are required to come to class (on time); those not scheduled don't have to come. 
Thank you for your attention.
p.s.
Don't read for your presentation.

sources.locator: ann[5] · Posted on: Monday, October 16, 2023 04:48:08 PM CST
sources.quote:
Please note that your Personal Essay (on the topic "My most ... moment") is due this Wed / Thur. But we WILL NOT meet in the classroom for you to submit the assignment. ONLY online submission is required. Please submit your essay to the VeriGuide assignment link created for your section. You should receive a confirmation email after successful submission - if you don't, double-check your submission. And if Google Chrome doesn't work well, try a different browser (such as Microsoft Edge or Firefox). 
Please attach no cover page for online submission.
A quiz on pronouns will be posted this Wednesday. Please study the ppt lesson before taking it.
Again, no classroom meeting this Wed / Thur. Thank you for your attention.
course staff
